query: Create VLAN 100 on L1. No members, no SVI.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - VLAN-E-01
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo

  tasks:
    - name: Create VLAN 100 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo config vlan add 100
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify VLAN Configuration
      raw: show vlan config
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: vlan_output
      failed_when: 
        - vlan_output.rc != 0
        - "'100' not in vlan_output.stdout"
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display VLAN Output
      debug:
        var: vlan_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
